human_reorganization: Generic formal kernels and extended KL statements are restricted to probabilities on standard Borel spaces. The printed density proof of the chain rule assumes finite input entropy and never subtracts infinities.
Finite-word potential boundedness is reproved by elementary unitary matrix entry bounds rather than the mapped quaternion staple radius.
The explicit bounded boundary-density ratio and first-step entropy upper bound 4|r| are printed human deductions of mapped partition and domination estimates, not additional formal declarations.

The residual contraction proof uses standard Borel reverse disintegration and conditional Jensen to reconstruct the classical data-processing argument; the formal source invokes the measure-theoretic KL library.

Boundary-preserving updates act on boundary/interior pairs; the positive loop comparison replaces the single chain state. Their state spaces and references are kept separate. The hemisphere event is not claimed gauge invariant.

Section 9 gives complete density and Tonelli proofs of actual P_r squared Haar minorization through a zero-trace band, with coefficient m(B_delta)*exp(-(1+3delta)r). Halving yields a genuine residual, all measurable powers and the explicit count of pairs.

Convergence in total variation to the already constructed stationary law and uniqueness are labelled human consequences of the oscillation estimate, not new mapped formal theorems. The reset reference is Haar, not the stationary tilted law, so no invariant residual or entropy-reference transfer is inferred.

At a zero-trace current state the trace-product loop row is exactly Haar. The mapped Wilson mismatch is eventual at large coupling; the printed all-r-positive mismatch is a labelled human symmetry/strict positivity proof using the nonempty Haar-supported neighborhood of the identity. The Wilson argument retains the inverse boundary convention and actual relative-holonomy tilt.
Near-exponent-one rate uses delta=eta/3 and a positive eta-dependent band prefactor. No endpoint optimality, coupling-uniform rate, physical-spacing identification or continuum mass gap is claimed.
novelty: Classical formalization companion; no new heat-bath obstruction, strict data-processing phenomenon or mass-gap claim.
